recognize_zh: 血液抹片中兩顆中型淋巴細胞，核圓形略不規則、染色質粗塊狀，細胞質量中等淡藍；本張放大倍率下細胞質顆粒不明顯，形態接近成熟淋巴球，需靠長期淋巴球增多與 NK 細胞表型診斷。
features: Two medium-sized lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Coarse, clumped mature chromatin without visible nucleoli
Moderate rim of pale-blue cytoplasm; azurophilic granules not clearly resolved at this magnification
Red cells normochromic with central pallor and scattered stomatocyte-like slit forms
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells, some with slit-like central pallor, and adequate scattered platelets. Two medium-sized lymphocytes are present with round to slightly irregular nuclei, coarse mature chromatin, no nucleoli, and a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm. Cytoplasmic azurophilic granules are not clearly resolved in this field, so large granular lymphocyte morphology is only suggested. In a patient with years of stable lymphocytosis and an NK-cell phenotype on flow cytometry, findings are consistent with chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so separation relies on flow cytometry showing surface CD3 and a clonal TCR rearrangement in T-LGL versus sCD3-negative CD16/CD56+ NK cells with abnormal KIR expression.
ANKL presents acutely with cytopenias, organomegaly and EBV-positive atypical cells with open chromatin, unlike this indolent mature-appearing population.
Reactive LGL expansions are transient (e.g., viral, post-transplant) and polyclonal with normal KIR distribution.
